FAQ.Q1_Q: How does Koralytics use football statistics across academies?
FAQ.Q1_A: We aggregate anonymized performance data (e.g., average pass accuracy, sprint speeds by age group) to create competitive benchmarks. No personally identifiable information (PII) is ever exposed.
FAQ.Q2_Q: Can parents and players log in directly?
FAQ.Q2_A: Yes, Koralytics provides dedicated portals for players and parents to track individual growth curves, match stats, attendance records, and schedules transparently.
FAQ.Q3_Q: Is data isolated between different academies?
FAQ.Q3_A: Absolutely. Every academy's private operational, financial, and personal data is completely isolated within tenant boundaries. Only anonymized, aggregated football metrics contribute to overall ecosystem analytics.
FAQ.Q4_Q: How quickly can our academy onboard?
FAQ.Q4_A: Onboarding takes less than 24 hours. Once your academy account is initialized, branch managers can invite coaches, register squads, and begin tracking telemetry immediately.
FAQ.Q5_Q: What hardware or sensors are required for telemetry?
FAQ.Q5_A: Koralytics works out of the box with standard mobile tablets and web browsers for manual drill & match input. It also integrates seamlessly with GPS player vests and optical camera video systems.
FAQ.Q6_Q: How are minor athletes' data protected?
FAQ.Q6_A: We enforce strict minor data protection protocols. Scouters and external users cannot view minor contact details or personal IDs; only sports telemetry radar metrics are visible under parental consent.

PRIVACY.HERO_SUB: Our explicit commitment to minor protection, 100% academy data ownership, and strict PII anonymization firewalls.
PRIVACY.SEC1_LEAD: Koralytics enforces strict regulatory compliance policies governing all data collection, storage, and processing for young athletes and children under 18.
PRIVACY.SEC1_P1_DESC: Minor athlete profiles can only be created and managed under authorized academy administration with parent/guardian portal verification.
PRIVACY.SEC1_P2_DESC: Personally Identifiable Information (PII) such as home addresses, phone numbers, and school details are strictly encrypted and hidden from non-authorized users.
PRIVACY.SEC1_P3_DESC: Scouters and external talent queries can view sports performance radar metrics only. Direct communication with minor athletes is completely disabled; inquiries route directly to parents and head coaches.
PRIVACY.SEC2_LEAD: Every sports academy, club, and organization using Koralytics retains 100% absolute legal ownership of their operational, financial, and athlete data.
PRIVACY.SEC2_P1_DESC: Koralytics never sells, leases, or trades private academy data, subscription histories, or contact records to third-party advertisers or data brokers.
PRIVACY.SEC2_P2_DESC: Academy managers can export complete squad telemetry, drill records, and financial reports in structured JSON or CSV format at any time without penalty.
PRIVACY.SEC2_P3_DESC: Upon contract termination, all private academy databases and isolated tenant tables are purged permanently within 30 days in compliance with deletion SLAs.
PRIVACY.SEC3_LEAD: Understanding the explicit firewall between private personal identifiable information (PII) and public/aggregated football performance metrics.
PRIVACY.SEC3_PUB_1: Avg Pass Accuracy by Age Group
PRIVACY.SEC4_LEAD: By registering an academy account or accessing Koralytics portals, you agree to comply with our platform terms of service.
PRIVACY.SEC4_P1_DESC: Koralytics commits to a 99.8% monthly uptime SLA for core telemetry databases and match recording servers.
PRIVACY.SEC4_P2_DESC: Academy admins, coaches, and parents are responsible for safeguarding password credentials and enforcing multi-factor security on admin accounts.
PRIVACY.SEC4_P3_DESC: Academies must submit authentic match data and refrains from automated bot queries or scraping telemetry analytics APIs.
